Introduction
This document outlines the equipment 
inspection I1, which must be performed every six months as indicated by M6 in 
the title block.
This test 
to inspect the eddy current transducer (five types) to measure shaft 
eccentricity,
The first draft initiated by eng. Ashraf Farid, and tested by eng. Mona Galal, revised by 
EDEPC quality control eng. Abdl Menem Al Emam, accepted by general manager 
eng. Aly Abd Elwhab, and approved by eng Fathy Mahmod Ragab: Head Sector 
of Talkha power station.
This document accepted by eng. Samir Abd El Gilil; 
 EDEPC inspection & quality control general director, MPIS coordinator, and certified by accountant Mahmoud Soliman: 
 EDEPC admin & financial inspection & quality control's general director, and 
 supervisor of inspection & quality control's head sector.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding 
 the work area is required.
Safety 
 and healthy equipment must be used 
 (safety helmet, safety shoes, ...etc).
Unit should be out of service.
Tools and Equipment
Digital Multimeter type Fluke 85
Screw driver
Work to be Carried Out
Measure resistance between coaxial cable and 
 shield (fig .1) the measuring value should be equal to (0.8/1.2 Ώ 
 ) and also the measuring value between surface / coaxial cable, 
 surface / shield should be tends to ∞ Ω.
If the measuring value in step 1 is not the value 
 (0.8/1.2 Ω, ∞ Ω 
 ) then the transducer is defected and should be changed.
